lines: Storms have a way of waking old stone, {player}. If you still mean to follow {quest}, keep your wits near {target_x}, {target_z}.
A night like this makes the deep roads restless. Your map still points {direction}, toward {target_x}, {target_z}.
Thunder carries strangely over ancient cities. Bring back {proof_item}, and I will know the trail was true.

leave_option.label: Leave
leave_option.response: The map will wait. The storm may not.
